privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy and personal data processing for Aura Influences.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Body: The controller of personal data collected on Aura Influences (“Aura”) is Jonathan Pugnat, reachable at <email></email>.
privacy.s2Intro: Aura only collects data needed to operate the service:
s2Items: Email address and user profile (via Clerk)
Attributes of the virtual influencers you create
Generated content (photos, videos, captions) and their metadata
Billing history (via Stripe; card details are not stored by us)
Social accounts you choose to connect (handles only)
Technical logs (IP, user-agent) for security and debugging
privacy.s3Intro: Your data is used exclusively to:
s3Items: Provide the service (generate content, manage your influencer catalog)
Publish to your social accounts only if you explicitly allow it
privacy.s3NoSale: No data is sold to commercial third parties.
privacy.s4Intro: Aura relies on the following subprocessors, who process your data under their own policies:
s4Items: Replicate, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google — AI models (prompts are sent to their APIs)
Meta (Facebook/Instagram) — only if you enable the Instagram integration
privacy.s5Body: Account data is kept while your account is active. After you delete your account, all data is erased within 30 days, except accounting records retained for 10 years under the French Commercial Code.
privacy.s6Body: Under the GDPR you have rights of access, rectification, objection, portability and erasure. To exercise them, see our <deletion>data deletion page</deletion> or write to <email></email>.
privacy.s6Cnil: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French data protection authority).
privacy.s7Body: Aura only uses cookies strictly required to operate (Clerk session, UI preferences). No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are set.
privacy.s8Body: For any question about your data: <email></email>

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the Aura Influences service.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.s1Body: These terms govern use of Aura Influences (“Aura”), a platform for creating virtual influencers and generating AI-assisted content.
terms.s2Body: By creating an Aura account you accept these terms in full. If you do not accept them, you must not use the service.
terms.s3Body: You must be at least 18 years old to use Aura. By signing up you warrant that you have legal capacity to contract.
terms.s4Body: You are solely responsible for keeping your credentials confidential. Any activity from your account is presumed to be yours. You must immediately report unauthorized use to <email></email>.
terms.s5Intro: You agree not to use Aura to:
s5Items: Generate illegal, defamatory, hateful content or content that infringes others’ rights
Create influencers resembling real people without their consent
Generate child sexual abuse material (zero tolerance, systematic reporting)
Distribute misleading content without disclosing that it is synthetic
Attempt to access third-party accounts or Aura’s infrastructure
Resell access to the service or its generations as white-label without agreement
terms.s5Breach: Any breach results in immediate account suspension without refund.
terms.s6Body: You retain intellectual property in content you generate via Aura, within the limits of the underlying AI models (Replicate, Anthropic, Google). Aura reserves an anonymized, aggregated usage right to improve the service.
terms.s6Transparency: Transparency: under the EU AI Act, you agree to disclose the synthetic nature of generated content when you publish it on third-party platforms.
terms.s7Body: Aura offers free and paid plans. Payments are processed by Stripe. Unless stated otherwise, subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period. You may cancel at any time from billing — access continues until the end of the current period.
terms.s7Refund: No refunds are granted for started periods, except as required by law (14-day withdrawal for the first subscription, unless you have used paid credit).
terms.s8Body: Aura is provided “as is”. No 24/7 availability guarantee is offered during beta. If an outage lasts more than 24 hours, compensatory credits may be granted on request.
terms.s9Body: Aura’s liability is limited to the amount you paid in the last 12 months. Aura is not liable for how you use generated content, nor for consequences of publishing on third-party platforms.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by French law. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of Paris, after an attempt at amicable resolution.

deletion.metaDescription: How to request deletion of your account and all personal data on Aura Influences.
deletion.title: Delete your data
deletion.subtitle: Compliant with GDPR (Art. 17) and the California CCPA
deletion.intro: You may at any time request complete deletion of your Aura Influences account and all associated data (influencers created, generated content, billing history, connected social accounts).
deletion.emailStep3: include the email address you used to create your Aura account. No other information is required.
deletion.emailTip: Tip: you can click the email above — your mail client will open a pre-filled draft.
deletion.delayBody: Your request is processed within 7 business days and all your data is deleted from our systems (and subprocessors) within a maximum of 30 days.
deletion.confirmBody: You will receive a confirmation email once deletion is complete. Encrypted backups automatically expire within 90 days.
removedItems: All your virtual influencers and their configurations
OAuth access tokens (Instagram, etc.) are revoked
deletion.keptBilling: Accounting records (Stripe invoices) — kept 10 years, legal obligation under the French Commercial Code
deletion.keptLogs: Anonymized security logs — kept 12 months for abuse detection
deletion.keptNote: Retained data can no longer identify you personally.
deletion.thirdBody: Deletion on Aura does not automatically erase content you published on Instagram, TikTok or other platforms. You must delete it directly on those platforms.
deletion.claimBody: If you believe your rights are not respected, you may lodge a complaint with the CNIL at <cnil>cnil.fr/fr/plaintes</cnil>.
